selected_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original FluxRail web mascot concept, using the supplied image as visual STYLE REFERENCE only. Reference image: the supplied black and white cute manga girl holding a rectangular object. Match its understated hand-drawn Japanese manga charm: fine slightly uneven black ink outlines, plain flat shapes, flat uncolored hair without gloss, large expressive dark oval irises drawn with little vertical hatching, rounded cheeks, tiny uncertain open mouth, hand-hatched blush, relaxed oversized sleeves, compact bust composition. Avoid polished glossy game artwork, jewel eyes, gradients, airbrushing, shiny hair, 3D rendering, huge sparkling eyes, photorealism. Make a different original character with a fluffy chin-length bob, soft side locks, a small waterdrop hair clip, a simple soft beret with small rhythm star pin, broad sailor collar, roomy sleeves. She holds a SMALL original rhythm-game controller across her chest, visibly a compact rounded rectangular device with two round knobs and four large keys, simplified enough to stay readable. Subtle shy happy expression. Square centered composition with entire beret and upper body in frame, generous margin. Actually transparent background, no text or watermark, no background diagonal lines. Fine inner facial lines but readable outer silhouette for web header icon. Variant 2 PALE AQUA: same restrained manga linework, add only desaturated pale aqua flat fill to hair, navy ink outlines, ivory skin, white sleeves, two small muted pink accents on collar and cheeks. No gradients and no shiny highlights, mostly white and aqua, understated gentle Japanese manga mini-character.

Keep the same facial angle and expression. Remove all body, hands, controller and clothing beneath the head; only hair, face and complete beret are visible. Compact centered face filling most of square canvas with narrow safe margin so the eyes remain legible at 32px, keep all hair and beret within canvas. Actual transparent background. Do not change the approved design; this is a head-only icon adaptation.
controller_edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image 1, the existing FluxRail header controller illustration. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and exact composition/controller reference. Image 2 is the approved pale aqua anime girl, IDENTITY AND STYLE REFERENCE. Replace ONLY the white rabbit mascot perched on the TOP RIGHT edge of the controller with a small chibi bust of the SAME girl from image 2: fluffy pale aqua bob hair, white soft beret with navy band and small pink star, white waterdrop hairclip, expressive dark hatched manga eyes, shy tiny open pink mouth and hatch blush, white loose sailor outfit with navy collar. She peeks over the controller edge with two tiny sleeve-covered hands resting on that edge, where the rabbit paws were. She must be recognizable as the approved reference, using its fine navy manga outlines and restrained aqua flat colors. Do NOT add the tiny controller she holds in image 2: there is only the large existing controller from image 1. Preserve the entire existing music-game controller from image 1 exactly: perspective and silhouette, blue/white/pink colors, two round knobs, horizontal slider with pink handle, eight blue keys in two groups of four with central gap, two pink lower keys, and FLUXRAIL lettering. Preserve its highlights, shading, decorations, bows, clouds and lace doilies outside the rabbit area. Preserve layout, landscape proportions, and transparent background. Complete replacement of rabbit ears/head/body/bow; no rabbit left. Keep the girl contained in the previous mascot upper-right region, allowing a little extra room upward while leaving generous margin and never clipping the beret. The controller dominates the composition. No new text, watermarks, extra characters or background. Actual transparency, preserve existing alpha.
